title: feat(console): the ⌘K palette previews the selected record, creates a record from the query, and names what Enter does

_Requested by **Steedos** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9Ubb?thread=cmsg_018ETKaNwMZCNRYD7D8Q9UbbUq2j5tRRVo3TVY3wcS1Fdg)_

repo:objectstack#7 · zhuangjianguo · session_01QsR2jV3scu6UYPb42n5okQ

Clause-②: yes (widening) — eight new published language-pack keys, in all eleven packs: console.commandPalette.create, createAs, previewEmpty, enterOpenRecord, enterCreate, enterSwitchApp, enterApplyTheme, enterOpen
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- 在应用里打开搜索面板:搜到记录时右边显示选中记录的要点(标题和对象声明的关键字段),上下键跟着换;输入任意词,列表最后出现「新建『该词』为客户」等行,回车打开已填好名称的新建页;输入「新建」或对象名能找到「新建客户」这类入口;面板底部写明回车会做什么。
- 属于外壳体验对标 Attio 专题,落实维护者「立」的四条改进里的第 1 条(必做的前四项)。
- 出问题时用户最多看到预览或新建入口不对、点进一个空的新建页,不会改动任何数据,可以直接撤回。
- 请看下面的截图,确认右侧详情和新建行的样子是否符合预期。

## What changes

The ⌘K palette inside an app (`CommandPalette`, `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/`) gains the card's items 1 to 4. Which records search finds and their order, the full search page, mobile and the AI entry are untouched.

1. **Record preview on the right** (`PalettePreviewPane.tsx`). While the query finds records, the palette widens (`sm:max-w-3xl`) and draws the selected hit read-only through the existing `RecordPreviewCard` (object label, title by the ADR-0079 ladder, the object's declared `highlightFields` through the record page's highlight strip, field-level security applied). The selection is cmdk's own, now controlled (`value` / `onValueChange`), so ArrowUp/ArrowDown move the preview. When a new set of hits lands, the selection moves to the first hit. The pane is a CSS container query on the palette frame: below a 45rem (720px) frame it is `display: none`, so a narrow window shows the results alone and nothing scrolls sideways.
2. **Create "words" as OBJECT** (`paletteCreate.ts`). Once something is typed, the last group, "Create", offers up to three of the app's navigation objects, the object of the page the palette was opened on first, then the navigation's order. Enter opens `/apps/APP/OBJECT/new?TITLEFIELD=words`, the create page that already reads its query string as the create prefill. An object is offered by the same verdict as the list's New: `resolveAffordance('listNew', …)` (bucket, `userActions.create`, effective API operations, create grant), then the create action's toolbar `visibleWhen` (fails closed) and `disabledWhen` bound with no record, as `objectViewToolbarAffordances` binds them. A "create as" row additionally needs the object's title field (`resolveNameField`) to be a `text`/`textarea` field, not `readonly`, that the member may write on create (`createFormFields`), so the words always land.
3. **New OBJECT** entries, in the same group: one per creatable object whose label ("New Customer", the list button's own `console.objectView.newObject` key), object label, machine name or the words "create new" match the query. An object whose New entry the query found gets no "create as" row (the query names the action, not a record).
4. **Enter hint** (`PaletteEnterHint.tsx`). A footer names what Enter does to the selected entry, read off the first word of its cmdk value: Open record (record, recent), Create, Switch app, Apply theme, or Open (every navigation entry).

Eight new published `@object-ui/i18n` keys in all eleven packs, a widening of the language packs (Clause-② yes): `console.commandPalette.create`, `createAs`, `previewEmpty`, `enterOpenRecord`, `enterCreate`, `enterSwitchApp`, `enterApplyTheme`, `enterOpen` (zh-Hant regenerated by `gen:zh-hant`). No props or package exports change. README section of the palette updated. Changeset: `@object-ui/app-shell` + `@object-ui/i18n` patch.

## Read first (by risk)

1. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/CommandPalette.tsx` — the hunk that computes `createTargets` / `newRecordRows` / `createAsRows`, and the render-time block that moves the selection to the first record hit when `hitSignature` changes (state adjusted during render, not in an effect).
2. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/paletteCreate.ts` — `paletteMayCreate` (the New verdict) and `palettePrefillField`.
3. `ui/packages/app-shell/src/chrome/PalettePreviewPane.tsx` — the 150 ms settle before the by-id read.

## Tests

New file `CommandPalette.previewCreate-36286.test.tsx` (15 tests) against the real `CommandPaletteProvider` over the `find` fanout and `findOne`: the preview draws title + declared key fields and Enter opens the record; ArrowDown moves the preview and only the settled records are read (`findOne` called for C1 then C2, nothing else); the container-query classes; no pane and no wide palette without a hit; create-as order (route object first, else navigation order), the invoice the member may not create never offered, Enter lands on `/apps/crm/customer_36286/new?name=Zhang+San`; the empty palette and a cleared query offer no create row; "new" finds one New entry per creatable object and no create-as row; an object's name finds its New entry; the footer per entry kind; `visibleWhen` / `disabledWhen` / title-field gates as units.

## Acceptance notes

- **Create opens the create page, not the list's modal.** The palette navigates to `/apps/APP/OBJECT/new` (the route the bare data surface's New and a related list's New open; it reads the query string as prefill). The list page's New opens a modal through `AppContent`'s `handleEdit`, which is outside this claim's file surface; reaching it from the palette would mean a new prop wired there. Worth a decision if the modal is wanted.
- **Key fields are the declared `highlightFields` only.** An object that declares none previews its title alone: that is `RecordPreviewCard`'s rule, from the record page's 「没声明就不挑」 ruling, not a new choice. The card's acceptance line (industry, phone, email) holds for an object that declares them.
- **At most three "create as" rows** (`CREATE_AS_MAX`), a judgment to keep the list short in apps with many objects; every other creatable object is still one "New OBJECT" entry away by name.
- **The Create group comes last**, so Enter on a query that finds anything opens that thing; with the English word "new", records whose status is "new" come first and the New entries sit below them (the 「新建」 screenshot shows the Chinese case).
- **Home's palette** reads the host app's navigation, so it offers the same rows there; the Studio palette offers none (no records, no app).
- **One extra read per previewed record**: the hit payload carries the row, but `RecordPreviewCard` reads by id with `$expand` on the reference fields it shows, so lookups render as names; holding an arrow key reads nothing until the selection rests 150 ms.
- The showcase's account object is labelled "Account (Success Overlay)" by that example; the screenshots show it as served.
- The de pack's quote-pair count pin moves 121 to 122; a sibling PR adding another „“ pair will need the same one-line bump on merge.
- Item 5 of the card (the "current page" group on the empty palette) is not in this PR.

## Verification

Two minutes: `cd examples/app-showcase && pnpm exec objectstack dev --seed-admin --fresh -p PORT`, then in `ui/apps/console` `DEV_PROXY_TARGET=http://localhost:PORT pnpm exec vite --port VPORT --strictPort`; sign in, open Accounts, press ⌘K, type `north`: Northwind is selected and the right pane shows Lifecycle / Industry / Annual Revenue; type `张三丰` and press Enter: the account create page opens with Account Name filled.
